consequence.statement: The new optional field enables enhanced flexibility for multi-tenant Azure environments using managed identities; existing configurations are unaffected.

assertion.statement: A new optional `tenantID` configuration field is added to the AzureDNS provider in Issuer, ClusterIssuer, and Challenge resources for specifying the tenant ID when using managed identities with service principals.
